BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Cerberus!!
Sir!
Hey, you're the choreman.\nHave you finished cleaning the garden?
Oh, um... I had no time for that...\nSir, are you feeling tired?
Ha ha, I'd like to say I'm alright but... The guys\ninfested by the black crystals are trying to go\nout to the world beyond here from this spring.
They come to here again and again no matter how\nmany times I drive them away...\nTo be honest, I'm exhausted...
Oh? Who are you?
Huh? Grecia asked you to save Dunkelis?\nYou're a human, right? Are you crazy?
How to get to the Cradle of Soldiers?\nIt's okay to tell you but you can't enter there\nwithout the charm...
Heh! You're so persistent, doggy!!
Gah!!
Hey, a human like you can't beat it alone!\nArgh... It might not be enough but I'll support\nyou! Let's do this!!
My gosh. You remind me of the human who beat me\nin the human world long time ago.\nIt's surprising to see a human like you.
Well, since Grecia asked you for help, you must be\na reassuring ally... Thanks.
You go rescue Dunkelis and Vatendeth, right?\nBut as you can see, I have to guard this spring\nin place of Varcene...
I'll leave them to you, alright? Also, our\ncommander, Halios, he's Vatendeth's big brother\nand Zolban the Dark Captain of Wind are missing...
They must be captured somewhere in the domain.\nCan you go rescue them as well?
Oh, I almost forgot.\nYou can't enter the Cradle of Soldiers without\nthe charm, you know? Huh? You didn't know that?
Meh! ...Well, I know everyone's having a hard\ntime fighting against the monsters and soldiers...
You need to find the charm to proceed...
Huh? Where's the charm, you ask?\nHey, it's in front of you.
Look, there...
What? The charm??\nI-I don't have such a thing and nobody gave it\nto me...
W-W-Whaaaaat?!\nS-Sir, what's going on?!
You know what? The charm helps you work as a\nchoreman in the form of human beings.
Really?! I didn't know it was on my back!
There was no way you could notice.\nDunkelis put it while you were sleeping in the\nform of souls.
It's the only charm that I know...\nHuh? You can take it off.\nHe'll get back to the form of souls though.
W-Wait, wait, wait.\nI can't work without it.
You don't need to think about it.\nJust take him with you.
Fida, you can work as an attendant, right?
I'll protect the spring with my subordinates and\ntake over your job on the garden while you're off.\nGo work for the human being.
I-Is that okay with you?\nProtecting the spring from the monsters is hard\nalready...
Who do you think you are talking to?!\nI said I'll do it!!\nDon't worry about me! Go, right now!!
Y-Y-Yes, sir!\nS-So, you're an adventurer... right?\nOkay, I'm ready to go.
